other_failure_modes.name: Improper test set imputation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent imputes missing values in the test set using statistics (like the median) calculated from the test set itself, rather than statistics learned from the training set. This can cause inconsistent predictions in production when test data batch sizes vary or when predicting on single instances.

summary: The agent implements a robust pipeline with deep learning and GBDT models, 5-fold cross-validation, out-of-fold target encoding, and SLSQP-based ensembling. However, it suffers from unsupervised data leakage by calculating feature frequencies and group aggregations on the combined train and test datasets. Additionally, it incorrectly imputes missing values in the test set using test set statistics rather than training set statistics.
